title: Paternal-line comparisons
dataset_scope: 23 saved Y67 tester observations, plus one separate A823 comparator. These are observation rows, not 23 independently documented paternal families. No fresh account data were read for this table; primary comparison-reading dates are retained per link.
interpretation_rules: Exclusions apply to the specific observed typed lines, never to every family with the surname.
Repeated testers, surname spellings and nested branches are not independent confirmations. No independent-family count is established.
Official Y67 GD, extended STR differences, single-copy lower bounds and SNP differences are different measures; only official same-level Y67 GD appears in that column.
A close STR distance cannot establish recentness. Broad placement, no-call or absent match-list entry is not a negative genotype.
McMaster/McMasters separation retains qualitative read-view limits; it is not calibrated raw sequence QC.
No surname probabilities, precise pairwise dates, former-surname direction, Aaron-level genetic assignment or confidence change is supplied. An untested family remains possible.

dependency_groups.reason: Shared downstream McMaster/McMasters path; two terminal assignments. Three observations do not establish three independent paternal families.
Kelly's saved path includes Brown's BY76755 branch. Different surname labels are not independent branch evidence; documentary relationship remains unknown.
McCormack's saved path descends through McCormick's BY81068 branch. Broader shared placement is not independent-family proof.
